responsibility: This header declares option_proposer, the small service class used by the GCC driver to suggest corrections for unrecognized options and to implement option auto-completion. It exposes the APIs for nearest-option lookup, completion result generation, and completion printing, while hiding the internal cached vector of candidate option strings populated from the generated option metadata.
same_name_distinction: Declares the option_proposer service class and its public/private methods for option correction and completion. Unlike opt-suggestions.cc, it does not compute candidates or perform spellchecking itself; it exposes the interface and cache member used by the implementation.
